name: civics-test-kit
description: The complete USCIS naturalization civics test as a dependency-free TypeScript engine: both official question banks (2008: 100 questions, 2025: 128 questions) with official acceptable answers and 65/20 + dynamic-answer flags, deterministic answer matching, SM-2 spaced repetition, authentic mock-interview mechanics (real early-stop rules), and seeded Monte Carlo readiness estimation.
author: Nityanand Gupta
